=== Level 40–80: Battlestaves ===
{{plinkp|Celastrus bark}} Fletching [[Battlestaff|battlestaves]] requires one piece of [[Celastrus bark]], and yields 80 experience per bark. Only level 40 is needed to fletch a [[battlestaff]], which makes it a better training method than fletching bows in this level range, but can be more costly. At level 80, players can fletch [[Magic shortbow|magic shortbows]] which yields more experience per action. With a [[Fletching knife]], the XP rates improve significantly.
